messages:
Ana: Quick sync — finalizing prod cutover acceptance. Need sign-off on SLA windows, docs, support rota, monitoring alerts, and pricing surge plan. Posting a minimal checklist. Please react with :thumbsup: when you’ve confirmed.

Kevin: Can you drop the checklist here? I'll confirm infra stuff.

Ana: ```
Cutover acceptance checklist v0.3
- SLA: 99.95% p99 latency target for hosted; 99.9% availability for Dedicated
- Docs: Quickstart, Troubleshooting, Rollback steps, Rate limit guidance
- Support: Oncall rota coverage + escalation matrix (24/7 for P0, business hours for P1)
- Monitoring: Token-level latency dashboards, error budget burn alert, anomaly detector
- Pricing: Surge cap, burst billing floor, pilot customer pricing table
Owners: SLA=Kevin, Docs=Maria, Support=Devon, Monitoring=Kevin, Pricing=Sarah
Sign-off needed by EOD Wed
```

Maria: Docs owner here — noted. I'll get owners to make quick drafts for Quickstart and Rollback. Can you clarify the doc retention requirement for audit? @Sarah

Sarah: For private deployments we need 12 months of audit logs accessible via KMS. Hosted customers: 6 months with option to extend. I'll add financial constraints to pricing table.

Devon: Support rota: we can cover P0s 24/7 but need 2 week handover for new hires. Also request a runbook template from Docs (Maria) for common KG => KV cache issues :eyes: 

Kevin: Runtime note — p99 latency target is fine but we should gate on sequence length 2-1024; anything longer should route to a cheaper variant. Also we need a fallback model for when GPU pool exhausted.

Ana: Good catch. Add routing fallback to checklist. Also add "smoke test script" that runs a gen + embed sample across regions.

OpsBot: deploy-bot: New canary rollout scheduled: canary-2027-03-18T09:00Z -> 10% traffic -> target 30m burnin. Will post logs to #eng-runtime.

Kevin: I'll validate canary burnin metrics and latency histograms before sign-off.

Maria: I'll produce two small runbooks: Quickstart (customer-facing) and Oncall Playbook (internal). ETA Wed noon.

Devon: I'll draft escalation matrix and assign primary/secondary for first 30 days. ETA Wed 3pm.

Sarah: Pricing note: propose surge cap at 2x baseline for burst billing; pilot customers can opt-in. Putting spreadsheet in shared drive: https://drive.redwood/surge-pricing-draft

Ana: Owner action items summarized:
- Kevin: SLA, fallback routing, canary validation
- Maria: Docs + runbooks
- Devon: Support rota + escalation
- Sarah: Pricing table + audit retention
Please drop :thumbsup: or call out blockers. We need a single sign-off thread message by EOD.

Kevin: :thumbsup: I'm good assuming fallback model shipped.

Maria: :thumbsup: will post drafts.

Devon: :thumbsup:

Sarah: :thumbsup: but will ping legal if audit retention impacts contracts.

Ana: Thanks all — I'll compile final acceptance artifact and post in this thread when ready. If anyone sees a blocker, reply here. :raised_hands:

(OpsBot): incident-check: No active P0s in the last 24h. Canary schedule confirmed.
